description: Korean monthly rent tax credit (월세 세액공제, 조세특례제한법 제95조의2): 17% when total salary ≤ 55M KRW (comprehensive income ≤ 45M), 15% up to 80M (70M), rent up to 10M KRW a year, plus the 10% local income tax reduction. Optional tax before credit caps the credit.

income.description: Total salary (wage earners) or comprehensive income amount (KRW)

months.description: Months of rent paid this year

taxBeforeCredit.description: Income tax left before this credit (optional cap) (KRW)

title: calculate kr monthly rent credit
